fusions.name: Scything Arc
fusions.desc: A wide curved cut that deals 14 damage to everything caught in it, with a 40% chance to leave targets [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Harvest Toll
fusions.desc: A thrown cut that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Rest
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Reaper's Pause
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 6 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
